articles.title: eMudhra security lapse explained | Co-founder Kaushik Srinivasan on what went wrong
articles.description: How did weak security keys go undetected at eMudhra through two audit cycles and what does the incident mean for customers? In this interview with The Economic Times, eMudhra co-founder Kaushik Srinivasan explains how a script error and human oversight led to weak cryptographic keys in the company’s website certificate infrastructure. He addresses questions about the checks that missed the weakness, the company’s response and its decision to exit the global SSL/TLS website certificate business.
